# How to use this file

This is the project memory for Pathwise. Read it before starting work.

- **Part 1, Current state:** what is actually built, deployed and decided, as of the date at its top. Newest truth.
- **Part 2, Reference:** external sources, endpoints, limits.
- **Part 3, Q & A:** open questions for the user. Answered questions move to `docs/decisions.md` (decisions, numbered and dated) or `docs/findings.md` (what the APIs and the regulation turned out to contain).
- **Appendix A, Original plan:** the plan as first written (2026-10-20). Kept for history; where it conflicts with Part 1 or `docs/decisions.md`, those win.

Working agreements (from the user):

- The user steers through this file ("see notes"). Keep the Q & A current: add new questions, remove answered ones.
- Commit and push often (GitHub, HTTPS remote).
- Never guess thresholds, codes, mappings or FinnPRIO fields; take them from tables or ask.
- Never commit or bundle keys. Keys only in env vars or the git-ignored `API_kays/` folder.
- EPPO, SSB and Lovdata results are deterministic; the LLM never sets numbers or classes.
- Tables follow tidy principles: one value per column, CN8 code in its own column.
- UI and write-up in English (Norwegian names only for searching Lovdata and SSB labels).
- Test species: `C:\Users\dafl\Downloads\master_species.xlsx` (318 pests). Bark beetles such as *Ips* spp. and AGRLAX (*Agrilus anxius*) are the usual checks.

# Part 1: Current state (2026-10-20)

## Status

- **App:** complete for v1. Single input, four panels, LLM write-up. All 318 test pests run through the pipeline without R errors (final debugging pass, decision 45).
- **Tests:** all offline tests pass (253 expectations) (`testthat::test_dir("tests/testthat")`).
- **Git:** https://github.com/floedaniel/Pathway, branch `main`. Last deployed code: `dbca7e9` (2026-10-20, includes decisions 52-54). Redeploy after changes with `Rscript dev/deploy.R`.
- **Deployed:** Posit Connect Cloud, account `danielflow` (logged in through RStudio).
  - App: https://01a158ac-9fd3-b5d5-8776-1d40f1995348.share.connect.posit.cloud/
  - Dashboard: https://connect.posit.cloud/danielflow/content/01a158ac-9fd3-b5d5-8776-1d40f1995348
  - Start page verified (HTTP 200, input visible, so the keys arrived). A full run on the server has not been tested yet.

## What the app does

Answers FinnPRIO **ENT3**, "How large a volume of the considered host plant commodity is traded into the PRA area annually?", for Norway.

**Core rule (user, 2026-10-20, decision 52):** only SSB imports from the countries where the pest is present (EPPO distribution) are used, for every pest. *A. anxius*: Canada and USA, nothing else. Norway is never an origin.

**Input:** one centred field, "EPPO code or scientific name" (e.g. `AGRLAX` or `Agrilus anxius`), and Run. No checkboxes; the pathways shown are the ones derived for the pest.

**Flow** (`run_assessment()` in `R/pipeline.R`):

1. **Resolve input** (`resolve_input()`): an EPPO code is checked; an inactive code follows `replacedby` (e.g. LITYMC -> LITYCR). A name goes through `tools/name2codes` (preferred names first, then all names). Unknown -> stop "Unknown or non-pest EPPO code or name."
2. **EPPO host commodities:** scraped from `gd.eppo.int/taxon/{code}/pathwayshosts` (no API endpoint), cached 30 days. Category + host genus per row.
3. **Hosts:** EPPO hosts, classes Major host and Host only. Stops: no hosts; no Major host/Host.
4. **Classify hosts** from the EPPO taxonomy lineage: conifer / non_conifer / not_plant, plus family, genus and monocot flag. No plant host -> stop.
5. **Present countries:** EPPO distribution statuses starting with "Present". None -> stop. Origin countries = present countries minus Norway (`origins`, returned as `r$origin_countries`).
6. **Choose pathways** (`choose_pathways()`): from the host-commodity list via `data/eppo_commodity_map.csv`; if the list is empty or gives no computed pathway (e.g. soil only), fall back to host plants, labelled in the header.
7. **SSB 08801:** imports (kg, NOK) of the pathway's CN8 lines, 10 years (2016-2025), only from the origin countries (`ssb_imports(countries = origins)`: fetched and cached for all origins so pests share the cache, filtered right away). Median annual kg summed over those countries -> FinnPRIO class.
8. **Host search in SSB:** every 08801 label is searched for each host genus (Latin and Norwegian names), every hit listed with its status.
9. **Lovdata:** units of FOR-2000-12-01-1333 naming the pest, then origin rules (host genus + pest-present country, Norway excluded), then host-only units.
10. **Write-up:** fixed layout filled by R; the LLM writes one sentence per Lovdata unit.

**Stops** are typed conditions (`stop_app()` in `R/conditions.R`) shown as one red alert; nothing else renders and no LLM call is made. Messages: invalid_code, no_hosts, no_main_minor, no_plant_hosts, no_distribution, unit_mismatch ("expected kg"), no_pathway, missing_secret, bad_config.

**Screen:**

- **Header strip:** pest and code, where pathways come from (EPPO host commodities with count, or host plants with the reason), host counts (conifer / non-conifer / not plants), "SSB imports only from the N countries where the pest is present" (plus "also present in Norway" when so), years.
- **Panel 1, SSB table** (decision 54; user: "confusing and cluttered. Clear headings! Summary first, then clearly separate different pathways. Tables should be similar for comparison. And contain sums at the bottom"). All numbers from pest-present countries only.
  - **Summary:** "Imports into Norway from <countries> (where the pest is present), 2016-2025. Imports from other countries are not used." Table, one row per pathway: Pathway | Based on | kg per year (median 2016-2025) | ENT3 class | Largest source country | Largest customs code. Manual pathways listed with "assess manually". No total across pathways (one ENT3 per pathway).
  - **One card per computed pathway**, numbered ("1. Plants for planting", "2. Wood"); header shows ENT3 class and kg per year. Body: "Based on ..." line; conifer / non-conifer split as one sentence when both exist; then two tables with the same number columns: kg per year (median) | kg in total 2016-2025 | Share of total | NOK in total 2016-2025 | Years with imports (of 10).
    - "By country": Country | ISO | numbers | Largest customs code. "No recorded imports from: ..." below.
    - "By customs code" (one explanatory sentence): Customs code | What the code covers (short tariff label, full text on hover) | Only the host? | numbers. "Also counted, no recorded imports: ..." below.
    - Total row at the bottom of both: ENT3 amount* | sum of totals | 100 % | NOK sum | years with any import. "* Total per year = the ENT3 amount: the median of the yearly totals, not the sum of the medians above." Shares are of the 10-year total, so they add up to 100 %.
    - Notes as a small list at the bottom of the card (bark subtotal included).
  - **Where the host is named in the import statistics** (own card): Customs code | Valid years | Name in SSB | Host | Matched word | Counted?.
  - Code: `panel1_ui()` -> `summary_ui()`, `pathway_tables()` (numbers), `pathway_card_ui()`, `host_search_ui()` in `R/mod_table.R`.
- **Panel 2, SSB graph:** stacked bars per year, one facet per host group, top 6 origins + "Other countries", largest at the bottom. Only pest-present countries. Legend = "Country (code1, code2, code3)", the country's largest CN8 lines in the pathway. Caption explains the bars. (The all/pest-present switch was removed with decision 52.) PNG download. No "*" marker (removed on request).
- **Panel 3, Lovdata:** snippets with id (e.g. "Vedlegg 2, nr. 10"), link, copy button.
- **Panel 4, FinnPRIO write-up:** per computed pathway an editable text box, Copy, Regenerate, labelled with its source (model or fallback).
- **Derived inputs** (collapsed): present countries, EPPO host-commodity table (category, host, EPPO code, FinnPRIO pathway, status), host plant table.
- **Footer:** fetch dates only (EPPO, SSB with table update date, Lovdata, thresholds reviewed). The disclaimer sentence was removed on request.

## Method details

### Host classification (`R/classify_hosts.R`, decision 19)
- conifer: lineage contains Pinopsida, Pinales or Coniferales.
- non_conifer: any other plant (kingdom Plantae), incl. herbaceous plants, cycads, Ginkgo, ferns. No woody test (the woody list was dropped).
- monocot: EPPO category "Basal monocotyledons" or "Commelinids".
- EPPO commodity groups used as hosts: 2PLAN plants and 2WOOP woody plants -> all plants (both groups, no genus filter); 2VEGP, 2FRUP, 2ORNH, 2HERP -> non_conifer. Unknown group -> all plants.
- Taxonomy cached permanently per host code.

### Pathways (`R/pathways.R`, `data/eppo_commodity_map.csv`)
FinnPRIO ids. Hitchhiking, natural spread and intentional introduction are removed (decision 27).

| EPPO category | FinnPRIO pathway | Status | CN8 scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| plants for planting | plants_for_planting | computed | 0602 |
| bulbs or tubers | plants_for_planting | computed | 0601 |
| non-squared wood | wood | computed | 4403, 4401 firewood/chips, 4404 |
| squared wood | wood | computed | 4406, 4407 |
| bark | wood | computed | 4401 40-49 waste incl. bark |
| packaging material | wood | computed | 4415 (only packaging traded as goods) |
| manufactured articles | wood | computed | 4416, 9406.10 (partial; 4409-4421 not included) |
| plant waste | wood | computed | 4401 40-49 (partial) |
| seeds | seeds | manual | - |
| cut flowers or branches, pollen | other_plant_parts | manual | - |
| fruits or vegetables, stored products | food_fodder | manual | - |
| soil/growing medium, agricultural machinery, all commodities | - | info | no CN line |

Fallback (no EPPO list, or a list with only info categories such as soil): both computed pathways (plants_for_planting and wood) for all host plants, with all their CN8 categories; 0601 counts only when a host is a monocot (`choose_pathways()`, `pathway_info()`). With an EPPO list, 0601 follows the list (bulbs or tubers) instead of the monocot rule.

### CN8 lines (`data/commodity_cn8.csv`, built by `dev/build_commodity_cn8.R`)
- 134 lines: 32 plants_for_planting, 102 wood. Built from SSB metadata + the customs tariff JSON.
- Columns: pathway, cn8 (versioned, e.g. `06029021_2011`), description (SSB), tariff_description, tariff_label (unique short label), commodity_group (conifer / non_conifer / both / monocot), eppo_category, genus, excludes_genera, flags (upper_bound, mixed, waste, with_bark, ...), source, valid_from, valid_to, notes, reviewed.
- Scope: plants = all 0602 (vedlegg 5A nr. 1) + 0601; wood = vedlegg 5A nr. 8 scope matched on wording + 9406.10. Out: tropical wood, eucalyptus round wood, pellets/briquettes, impregnated/treated wood.
- **Genus filter** (decisions 33, 39, 44, 45): genus-specific lines (furu/Pinus, gran = Picea AND Abies per tariff, eik/Quercus, bøk/Fagus, bjørk/Betula, poppel/osp Populus, ask/Fraxinus, lønn/Acer, kirsebær/Prunus, Rhododendron, Rosa, Pelargonium, Chrysanthemum lists) count only when a host is in the genus. Residual lines ("other conifers / broadleaved") count only when a host genus is outside the listed genera; judged on genera only, not families. Mixed lines count for any host. Hosts known only above genus are not filtered.
- 06029021 is all trees and shrubs with soil n.e.s. (tariff), not the genera SSB's short label lists. Its genus restriction was a bug and is removed.
- Rebuild after SSB or tariff changes: `Rscript dev/build_commodity_cn8.R` (also writes `data/genus_names_no.csv`).

### Volume class (`R/volume_class.R`)
- `data/finnprio_thresholds.csv`: `x < 1,000,000` small; `x <= 10,000,000` medium; else large. kg only.
- Imports are only from pest-present countries (Norway excluded). Sum those countries per year first, then the median over 10 years, then classify.
- `all_hosts` row (union of lines, role `ent3`) is the ENT3 answer; group rows are info.
- No imports from those countries -> "none recorded" (not `non_existent`); the assessor decides.
- History: first all origins (Class A) + pest-present class (Class B); then all origins + pest-present kg/share as context (decision 29); now pest-present countries only (decision 52).

### Host search in SSB (`R/host_search.R`, decision 47)
- User's rule: always search SSB 08801 for the host plants (e.g. bjørk for *A. anxius*).
- Terms: genus (Latin) + Norwegian names from `data/genus_names_no.csv` (131 names from the tariff). Whole words only.
- Exclusion clauses ("unntatt bjørk", "unnt av bartrær, eik", "ikke ...") are stripped first; a line excludes the host only if every matched term sits in an exclusion clause.
- Status per hit: "counted: <pathway>", "label excludes the host", "not counted: impregnated wood is excluded", "not counted: heading XXXX is outside the app's CN8 scope". ENT3 numbers are not changed by the search.

### Lovdata (`R/law_index.R`)
- Bulk archive `gjeldende-sentrale-forskrifter.tar.bz2` (21 MB), file `sf/sf-20001201-1333.xml`, parsed into 305 units (§ articles, annex rows, annex paragraphs). Cached 7 days.
- Terms: pest names + EPPO synonyms; higher taxa only as "<taxon> spp." (genus alone is no hit); aliases in `data/law_taxon_aliases.csv` (Scolytinae -> Scolytidae; Pinopsida -> Coniferales / bartrær); host genera; Norwegian country names of pest-present countries (Norway excluded).
- Tiers: pest_match, then origin_rule (host genus + pest-present country), then host only.

### Write-up (`R/prompts.R`, `R/mod_writeup.R`, decisions 40, 46)
Fixed layout, numbers and codes filled by R:

```text
ENT3: Small

Annual import into Norway of <scope> from the countries where the pest is present (<names>, or "the N countries ..." when more than 5): <mass> (median 2016-2025). Imports from other countries are not counted.[ The pest is also present in Norway.] The figure covers all ... so it is an upper bound.
<basis sentence>

Largest CN8 lines (median kg per year, share of total, kg in total):
<tariff label> (<code>): <mass> per year (<share>[, mixed line]), <mass> in total 2016-2025

Imports by country:
<Country>: <mass> per year (median 2016-2025)
  <tariff label> (<code>): <mass> in total 2016-2025
[N further countries with smaller imports (see Panel 1).]   (more than 10 countries with imports)
No recorded imports from: <countries>                         (first 15, then "and N more countries")

Regulation:
<Lovdata id>: <one LLM sentence>

Note: <pathway notes>
```

- The LLM (OpenAI, `gpt-5.5-2026-04-23`) writes only the Regulation lines: one sentence per unit, each must start with a Panel 3 id (`validate_regulation()`); otherwise the unit text is shown (`regulation_fallback()`). Cached per units + model; Regenerate bypasses the cache.
- Units: those naming the pest, then origin rules, in regulation order.
- No imports at all: "ENT3: none recorded" and "...: no recorded imports (2016-2025)".
- "mixed line" = flagged upper_bound AND not naming a host genus (`mixed_line(flags, genus)`); a birch-only code is never called mixed.

## Deployment (Posit Connect Cloud)

- Redeploy after code changes: `Rscript dev/deploy.R` from the project root. It reads the keys into the R session, sends them as encrypted environment variables (`envVars`), uploads 31 files (no tests, dev, docs, cache, keys, notes) and updates the same app (`appName = "pathwise"`, `forceUpdate = TRUE`). The script refuses to run if a key file would be in the bundle.
- After package changes: `renv::snapshot()`, then `Rscript dev/write_manifest.R` (113 packages, R 4.5.3), commit.
- The rsconnect records go to `rsconnect/` (git-ignored). A second account `danielapp@shinyapps.io` also exists but is not used.
- If envVars are ever ignored, set `EPPO_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` as secrets in the Connect Cloud UI.
- Caveats:
  - The app is public on the free plan: anyone with the link can run it, which uses the EPPO and OpenAI keys (small cost per run). Access can be restricted in the dashboard.
  - The first run on a fresh server is slow: it downloads the Lovdata archive and fills the caches. The cache does not survive restarts of the server.

## Known limitations

- Import statistics are recorded trade, not pest pressure or entry.
- CN8 lines cover whole commodity groups, so classes are an upper bound for the host-specific volume.
- Only countries EPPO records as "Present" count: gaps in the EPPO distribution and re-exports through third countries are missed.
- Conifer plants for planting appear only in catch-all 0602 lines.
- Most wood packaging travels with other goods and has no SSB line (4415 = packaging traded as goods).
- Manufactured articles are partial (4416, 9406.10 only); veneer 4408, plywood 4412, profiled wood 4409 show up in the host search as "outside scope" (Open question 5).
- Dicot bulbs/tubers are missed when EPPO has no list; soil has no CN line.
- Seeds, food and fodder, and other plant parts are not computed (manual).
- EPPO host commodities exist only for EPPO/EU-listed pests (80 % of A1/A2, 0 % of the Alert list); the rest use host plants.
- Mattilsynet holds genus-level import data (§ 20, § 23a); a data request, not in v1.

## Lessons and gotchas

- **SSB short labels mislead.** Always check the customs tariff wording (06029021, 4403 23 = fir and spruce).
- **Bash heredocs and `Rscript -e` halve backslashes** in regex. Write R scripts to a file with the Write tool and run them.
- **renv:** RStudio must restart R (Session > Restart R) after renv is activated, else "there is no package called 'config'".
- **Sourced code shares the global environment:** `do.call(c, ...)` picked up a global `c`; use `base::c`.
- **Regex:** Unicode classes like `\\p{L}` need `perl = TRUE`; without it the pattern silently never matches.
- **Genus vs higher taxon:** matching a pest's genus alone in Lovdata gave false hits (*Agrilus*); higher taxa count only as "X spp.".
- **Families switch on residual lines:** judge residual CN8 lines on genera only.
- Cold run ~30 s, cached a few seconds.
- `app.R` has a user-added `library(config)`, which masks `base::get`/`merge` and prints a warning. Not needed (settings use `config::get()`); see Open question 6.

## Results worth remembering

- **AGRLAX (*Agrilus anxius*), pest-present only (decision 52; walk-through in `docs/vignette.md`):** plants for planting 949 kg/year (small; 06029021 81 %), wood 49 144 kg/year (small; pallets 66 %, crates 29 %). 17 Lovdata units (2 pest, 5 origin rules). Only 6 SSB lines are birch-specific; of them only sawn birch had imports from CA/US (31 kg in total).
- **AGRLAX before decision 52 (all origins):** plants 35.3 million kg/year, wood 291.9 million kg/year, both large.
- **IPSXTY:** present in 44 countries incl. Norway (43 origins); plants 17.4 million kg (large), wood 435.2 million kg (large, Sweden 343 million kg/year). **XYLEFA:** 22 countries, plants 1.9 million kg (medium).
- **AGRLAX, earlier:** hosts all *Betula*, present in CA and US. EPPO list: plants for planting, squared and non-squared wood, bark, manufactured articles, packaging, all *Betula*. Before the genus filter 90 % of "non-conifer wood from pest-present countries" was oak; with it ~47 t/year (mostly pallets) instead of 5.3 million kg. Lovdata: Vedlegg 1 nr. 2.1 (pest), Vedlegg 4A nr. 45, origin rule Vedlegg 3 nr. 11 (*Betula* from Canada and USA).
- **IPSXCA wood (before decision 52):** all origins 1.26 billion kg; pest-present origins 0.43 million kg.
- **Sweep of 318 pests:** 215 get pathways from EPPO host commodities, the rest from host plants. XANTPD stops (no hosts in EPPO), which is correct.

# Part 2: Reference

## Repository
- GitHub: https://github.com/floedaniel/Pathway (public; remote `origin` uses HTTPS: `https://github.com/floedaniel/Pathway.git`; no SSH key on this machine).

## EPPO Global Database API v2
- Base URL `https://api.eppo.int/gd/v2`, key in header `X-Api-Key` (env `EPPO_KEY` or `API_kays/EPPO_beta.txt`). Rate limit 2000 requests / 10 s. Unknown codes return HTTP 400.
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.eppo.int/gd/v2/eppo_api_gd_v2.yml. v1 (`data.eppo.int/api/rest/1.0`, `?authtoken=`) is legacy.
- Endpoints used: `taxons/taxon/{code}/overview`, `/hosts`, `/taxonomy`, `/distribution`, `/names`; `references/distributionStatus`; `tools/name2codes`.
- Host classes: Major host, Host, Alternate, Wild/Weed, Experimental, Doubtful host, Non-host (no "Minor host").
- Host commodities: not in the API (only a count, `infos$pathwayhost`); HTML table `#dttable` on `https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/{code}/pathwayshosts`. User guide p. 13-14: `docs/reference/eppo_gd_general_user-guide.pdf`.
- Not this: https://eppo.cloud/api/docs belongs to "Eppo", an unrelated A/B-testing company.

## SSB, table 08801
- External trade by CN8 commodity and country, 1988 to the latest complete year: https://www.ssb.no/en/statbank/table/08801 (same data as the /no/ page; the app reads labels in Norwegian and country names in English).
- API: PxWebApi v2, `https://data.ssb.no/api/pxwebapi/v2/tables/08801/data` (open; max 800,000 cells per call, 40 calls/min). The old `api/v0` is legacy.
- Used: Mengde1 = kg (every line) and Verdi = NOK. Mengde2 (pieces, m³) is not used.
- Chapters: 06 = live plants (0601 bulbs and tubers, 0602 plants for planting); 44 = wood; 94.06.10 = prefabricated wooden buildings.
- CN8 codes carry a version suffix (`06029098_2016`). Land codes are ISO2 except CS_, XI, 97.

## Lovdata, FOR-2000-12-01-1333
- Forskrift om planter og tiltak mot planteskadegjørere: https://lovdata.no/dokument/SF/forskrift/2000-12-01-1333
- Source: Lovdata public data (open, updated daily), bulk archive of current central regulations: https://api.lovdata.no/v1/publicData/get/gjeldende-sentrale-forskrifter.tar.bz2 (file `sf/sf-20001201-1333.xml`). Service description: https://api.lovdata.no/om-api-tjenesten/
- Key annexes: vedlegg 1 and 2 (regulated pests, vedlegg 2 with host genera), 3 (origin bans), 4A (import requirements), 5A (certificate requirements; nr. 1 plants, nr. 8 wood scope; tariff numbers in an older format).
- Bark beetles: "Scolytidae spp. (ikke-europeiske arter)" (Vedlegg 2, nr. 10). Not named: Xylella, Aromia, Lymantria, Dendroctonus, Polygraphus, Fusarium circinatum.

## Customs tariff (Tolletaten)
- Dataset: https://data.toll.no/no/dataset/tolltariffstruktur (open data: section > chapter > heading > subheadings > 8-digit item, with HS6 number and references).
- JSON used: https://data.toll.no/dataset/6350e783-b989-4c7c-9ec0-de2dcb97363c/resource/68f78255-cbb0-4e75-86b1-3d5928816903/download/tolltariffstruktur.json (version 1.5; copy in `docs/reference/tolltariffstruktur.json`). All 105 current CN8 lines of the app are in it.
- Used by `dev/build_commodity_cn8.R` for `tariff_description`, `tariff_label` and the Norwegian genus names.

## OpenAI (write-up)
- Provider and model in `config.yml` (`llm.provider: openai`, `llm.model: gpt-5.5-2026-04-23`). Key: env `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `API_kays/tore_vkm_openai.txt`. Called through ellmer (`chat_openai`).

## Posit Connect Cloud
- Account `danielflow`, server `connect.posit.cloud`, app name `pathwise`. URLs in Part 1, Status.

### Next step: more host groups (feasibility report 2026-10-20, no code yet)
Background: only plants for planting and wood are computed today. Counts from the EPPO host-commodity lists of the 318 test pests (222 have a list):

| EPPO category | FinnPRIO pathway | Pests | Main hosts | Customs chapters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cut flowers or branches | other_plant_parts | 75 | Citrus (24), Pinus/Picea/Abies (17), Quercus, Vitis | 0603, 0604 (incl. Christmas trees) |
| fruits or vegetables | food_fodder | 56 | Citrus (16), tomato (12), potato (9), aubergine (8), Prunus, Pyrus, Malus, mango, Capsicum, cucurbits | 07, 08 |
| seeds | seeds | 23 | maize, groundnut, cotton, rice, grasses | 1209, 1005 10, 1201 10 ... |
| stored products / pollen | food_fodder / other_plant_parts | 3 / 1 | | |

134 pests have at least one category that is not computed; for 19 nothing is computed today; 24 have Solanum in such a category. EPPO often lists food hosts as species (Solanum lycopersicum, S. tuberosum), so the CN8 table needs species-level matching, not only genus.

Proposed order (my recommendation): (1) seed potatoes 0701 10 in plants for planting; (2) food and fodder, pilot on Solanum (tomato, potato, aubergine) + Capsicum, checked on Tuta absoluta, ToBRFV, Ralstonia, Clavibacter sepedonicus, Epitrix, then all fresh fruit and vegetables; (3) cut flowers, foliage and branches (incl. Christmas trees); (4) seeds.

8. **Order of work.** Go ahead in the order above (pilot on tomato/potato within food and fodder), or another order (tomato/potato only, or all categories at once)?
9. **Seed potatoes (gap found).** Seed potatoes are CN 0701 10, not 0602. For a pest with "plants for planting of Solanum tuberosum" the app counts the mixed 0602 lines and misses seed potatoes. Fix first: add 0701 10 to plants for planting, counted only for potato hosts?
10. **Processing state for food and fodder.** Count only fresh or chilled products (e.g. 0701, 0702, 0805), or also frozen (0710) and dried (0712)? My suggestion: fresh/chilled only (living material carries the pest).
11. **Seeds unit.** FinnPRIO assesses seeds in pieces; SSB 08801 gives kg. (a) use kg anyway, (b) convert with a thousand-seed weight per crop (needs a reviewed table), or (c) keep seeds manual?
12. **Pests without an EPPO list.** Today they get plants for planting and wood from their host plants. For food and fodder and cut branches: (a) use only codes that name a host species (e.g. 0702 tomatoes for a tomato host), (b) all codes of the chapter as an upper bound, or (c) not computed without an EPPO list?
13. **Thresholds.** Are the ENT3 kg limits (small < 1 million, medium <= 10 million, else large) the same for food and fodder, cut flowers/branches and seeds?
14. **Crop name table.** To map tariff wording to hosts ("tomater" -> Solanum lycopersicum, "poteter" -> S. tuberosum), the build script needs a Norwegian crop name -> Latin name table (draft from the tariff, about 150 fruit and vegetable lines, ~30 cut flower/foliage lines). OK that I draft it and you review it before it is used?

# Appendix A: Original plan (2026-10-20, superseded where Part 1 or docs/decisions.md differ)

Main changes since: single input is a code OR a name; pathways come from EPPO host commodities; woody list replaced by the taxonomic rule; kg only (no pc); median over 10 years; Class B replaced by pest-present kg and share; fixed pathways (hitchhiking etc.) removed; OpenAI instead of Claude/HF; write-up in a fixed layout with the LLM only for regulation sentences; footer disclaimers and the graph "*" removed; deployed on Posit Connect Cloud instead of a laptop; ENT3 from pest-present countries only (not the total of all origins).

read whole plan before you start!
Also see old_scripts for old snippets that can be re used (folder deleted 2026-10-20)

## Goal
Single input: EPPO code of the pest (e.g. XYLEFA). Everything else is derived.
Outputs, as four panels in this order:
1. SSB data table summary (with FinnPRIO ENT3 volume classes)
2. SSB graph (10 years)
3. Lovdata snippets
4. Write-up for FinnPRIO, copy-paste ready

## Scope
v1: plant hosts, groups `conifer` / `non_conifer`. Two pathways: plants for planting (0602) and wood (ch 44 + 94.06.10, scope of vedlegg 5A nr. 8), CN8 list in `commodity_cn8.csv`.
v2 (later): herbaceous hosts, crops, true seeds (unit pc). Out of scope now.
Hosts classified `other` or herbaceous are ignored for the CN8 pull.

## FinnPRIO ENT3
Question: "How large a volume of the considered host plant commodity is traded into the PRA area annually?"
Classes (exact option names): `non_existent`, `small`, `medium`, `large`.
- small: < 1 million kg or pc
- medium: 1-10 million kg or pc (inclusive)
- large: > 10 million kg or pc
- Official ENT3 = total volume into the PRA area regardless of place of origin.
- Non-existent applies when the pathway is hitchhiking, natural spread or intentional introduction. The app assumes plants for planting, so this is a manual override only.
- True seeds are assessed in pieces (v2).

## Two classes, both shown
- **Class A (total, official ENT3):** all origins summed. Drives the write-up by default.
- **Class B (pest-present origins only):** subset of origins where EPPO status is present. Labelled "informational, not ENT3". Shown in Panel 1 and marked in the graph.
- Write-up reports Class A as the ENT3 answer and mentions Class B in one sentence if it differs from A.
- If A and B differ, Panel 1 flags it.

## Principles
- EPPO, SSB and Lovdata outputs are deterministic and shown separately. Never LLM-generated.
- Volume classification is deterministic. The LLM must not reclassify or recompute.
- LLM only sees retrieved text, must cite Lovdata paragraph ids, must say "not found" if absent.
- LLM output is labelled as generated.
- Cache everything on disk, fetch date shown in UI.
- Secrets in env vars only: EPPO_KEY, HF_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
- Plots: ggplot2 with viridis scales.
- UI states that import stats show recorded trade, not pest pressure or entry, and that CN8 lines cover whole commodity groups, so classes are an upper bound for host-specific volume.
- Settings in config.yml (host status filter, ssb_years, volume_n, volume_stat, LLM provider/model, language).
- Never guess thresholds, codes, mappings or FinnPRIO form fields. Take them from tables/templates I fill in.

## Structure
app.R
R/mod_input.R, mod_table.R, mod_graph.R, mod_law.R, mod_writeup.R
R/api_eppo.R, api_ssb.R, volume_class.R, classify_hosts.R, host_to_groups.R,
R/law_index.R, llm_provider.R, cache.R, prompts.R, conditions.R
data/commodity_cn8.csv              (cn8, description, commodity_group, valid_from, valid_to, notes)
data/country_map.csv                (ISO2, EPPO code, SSB name, Norwegian name)
data/finnprio_thresholds.csv        (see below)
data/finnprio_writeup_template.txt  (FinnPRIO form fields, order, max length; filled in by me)
data/law/                           (Lovdata XML + index)
config.yml
tests/testthat/

## Flow
1. Validate code: `/taxon/{code}` must exist and be a pest. Else STOP: "Unknown or non-pest EPPO code."
2. Hosts: `/taxon/{code}/hosts`, keep status `main` + `minor` (fixed in config, no UI toggle). Stops for no hosts / no major or host.
3. `classify_hosts()`: Pinopsida (or Pinales / Coniferales) -> `conifer`; any other plant -> `non_conifer`; else `other` (ignored). Cached permanently per host code.
4. `host_to_groups(host_code)`: union over hosts = groups for the run. No plant host -> STOP.
5. Distribution: countries with status present only. None -> STOP.
6. Pest-present countries are used for Class B, marking in table/graph and the Lovdata search. They do NOT restrict the SSB query.
7. SSB: CN8 lines for the groups, ALL origin countries, 10 years; Class A and B from the thresholds; statistic from config; kg and pc never summed; unit check; no imports -> `none recorded`.
8. Lovdata: search pest name + EPPO synonyms, host genera, pest-present countries.
9. LLM receives labelled EPPO, SSB and LAW blocks and produces the write-up.

Stops are typed conditions (`stop_app("no_hosts")`) caught in the server and shown as one alert replacing all panels. Nothing downstream renders, no LLM call.

## Steps
1. **Scaffold**: renv, testthat, config.yml, `cache.R`, `conditions.R`.
2. **Lookup tables**: `commodity_cn8.csv` built by `dev/build_commodity_cn8.R`, `country_map.csv`, thresholds.
3. **EPPO** (`api_eppo.R`): verify endpoints, rate limits, taxonomy ranks first. Tidy tibbles.
4. **classify_hosts() + host_to_groups()**.
5. **Lovdata** (`law_index.R`): download, split into paragraphs/annex rows, local keyword index.
6. **SSB** (`api_ssb.R`): confirm CN8 by country and units first; chunk and cache; handle CN8 revisions.
7. **Volume class** (`volume_class.R`): pure functions, aggregate across countries before classifying, no double counting.
8. **UI** (`mod_*.R`): input, header strip, four panels, derived inputs expander, footer.
9. **LLM** (`llm_provider.R`): ellmer, provider switch, plain text, cites Lovdata ids, cached per input + model.
10. **Tests** (mocked API responses): stops, classification, class boundaries, aggregation, law search, write-up checks.
11. **Eval**: 5-10 known cases across Claude and 2-3 HF models, side by side for manual scoring. (Not done.)
12. **Deploy**: second laptop, `shiny::runApp(host = "0.0.0.0", port = 3838)`, Cloudflare quick tunnel. (Replaced by Posit Connect Cloud.)

## Order of work
Steps 1-5 first (no cost, testable), then 6-8, then 9-11, then 12. Commit after each step. Stop and ask when a table, endpoint, threshold, mapping or form field is ambiguous. Do not guess.

- Add groups to `commodity_cn8.csv`: `potato_seed`, `potato_ware`, `tomato`, `cut_flowers`, true seeds, etc. Keep seed and consumption separate (different regulation).
- Compute seeds, food_fodder and other_plant_parts from SSB (now manual).
- Group-specific Lovdata search terms.
